description: This file defines functions for migrating and removing sysfs configurations related to LEDs, as well as applying configuration changes in a system management context. It involves manipulating UCI configurations and logging updates.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates the sysfs path for a given LED configuration, applying specific transformations.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes the device name prefix from the sysfs path of an LED configuration, unless exceptions are matched.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Iterates over all LED configurations and applies migrate_led_sysfs.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Iterates over all LED configurations and applies remove_devicename_led_sysfs.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Commits configuration changes for a specific realm if there are pending changes.
